name: Head stack
description: Small cream name tags drop from above with a speed blur and pile up on the speaker's head, each a little crooked. Some land on the shoulder. The pile rides on the head as it moves. Then a gust blows them all off.
when: When you list many names, tools or labels people put on you: 'founder, editor, coach...'.
needs: the tags, each with where it lands (head or shoulder)
the cut time where it starts
a cutout of the speaker, for the head track (made in the steps)
